## PS5Save+ v0.1.0-alpha.8

Final alpha candidate: pairing refinement, HTTP recovery after PS5 standby, and updated documentation.

### Changes
- Reduced the active pairing-code resend interval from 10 to **5 seconds**. The same six-digit PIN remains valid only until its original two-minute expiry.
- **Dashboard standby recovery:** listens for `SIGCONT`, detects network IPv4 changes and socket failures, then closes and reopens its TCP 8755 listener. Retains the running backup process, server-side editor sessions and USB data. Retries a failed listener bind without restarting the backup engine.
- **Best-effort idle sleep prevention during copying:** invokes `sceSystemServicePowerTick()` at a maximum cadence of every 10 seconds while actively copying or verifying backup/USB data. It cannot override manual standby or HDMI-CEC Power Off Link.
- Rewritten README: concise, impersonal project documentation covering all supported backup features, USB selection and migration, protected editor sessions, installation and runtime limitations.

### Validation
The host test suite includes an HTTP server recovery test with repeated `SIGCONT` signals, plus existing notification, USB-selection, migration and multi-browser pairing regression tests. GitHub Actions cross-compiles the ELF using the PS5 Payload SDK.

**Console validation required:** recovery after actual PS5 Rest Mode, interaction with HDMI-CEC, and idle timer operation must be verified on the target firmware. Preserve an independent copy of important saves.

Based on [heni0xyz/PS5Save](https://github.com/heni0xyz/PS5Save), GPL-3.0. Uses the system power-tick approach described by [mortyzip/KeepAwake](https://github.com/mortyzip/KeepAwake).
